title: Embedding ordinary steps into extended steps
statement: For any word width $W$, ordinary program $P$, natural number $n$, and configurations $c,c'$, if $c'$ is reached from $c$ in $n$ ordinary steps, then for every output bit list $o$ and coin count $r$, the program obtained by replacing each instruction of $P$ by its base extended instruction takes $n$ extended steps from the configuration with ordinary state $c$, output $o$, and coin count $r$ to the configuration with state $c'$, output $o$, and coin count $r$. The input and coin bit lists used by the extended computation may be arbitrary.
hypotheses_covered: An ordinary computation of length $n$ from $c$ to $c$'
